description: r0b0tlab's SGLang SM121 profile for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B NVFP4 (e8f3c7c4; NVIDIA OpenMDW-1.1) with NVIDIA's official DFlash draft head (7fc1f1ff), from r0b0tlab/nemotron-3.5-lightning-sglang-dflash-sm121 at 3baf136c (MIT). Runs the kit's published image ghcr.io/r0b0tlab/nemotron-3.5-lightning-sglang-dflash-sm121:v0.1.0-sm121-dflash (sha256:b868b726..., pinned by digest, not rebuilt): the pinned day-0 lmsysorg/sglang Lightning image (arm64 image ID sha256:323c95b7, the one upstream's evidence used, whose 71 layers are the image's first 71) plus the kit's entrypoint and ready-gate scripts, which this recipe's launch arguments replace, and a thin Controller layer with Marlin W4A16_NVFP4 MoE, FP8 KV, FlashInfer attention and Mamba, float16 SSM state, DFlash block size 4, 50,016-token context (the evaluation window), 6 running requests and CUDA graphs to batch 8. The option lifts the SGLang context cap for upstream's 1,000,000-token capacity run, which upstream marks as a capacity row, not a quality window. Upstream claims (not measured here): 11-lane r0b0bench core-subset results in its results/evidence, and a 1M-token needle capacity pass. Physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning NVFP4 DFlash SGLang single Spark (r0b0tlab)
